text_en: Hannah prayed and said, “My heart exults in the Lord ; my strength is exalted in my God. My mouth derides my enemies, because I rejoice in my victory.
text_cn: 亚纳祈祷说： “我从心里喜乐于上主，我的头因天主而高仰；我可开口嘲笑我的敌人，因为我喜乐于你的救助。

text_en: “There is no Holy One like the Lord , no one besides you; there is no Rock like our God.
text_cn: 没有圣者，相似上主；除你以外，没有另一位；没有磐石，相似我们的天主。

text_en: Talk no more so very proudly, let not arrogance come from your mouth; for the Lord is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.
text_cn: 你们别再三说诳言，别口出豪语；上主是全知的天主，人的行为由他衡量。

text_en: The bows of the mighty are broken, but the feeble gird on strength.
text_cn: 壮士的弓已被折断，衰弱者反而力量倍增。

text_en: Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread, but those who were hungry are fat with spoil. The barren has borne seven, but she who has many children is forlorn.
text_cn: 曾享饱饫的，今佣工求食；曾受饥饿的，今无须劳役；不妊的生了七子，多产者反而生育停顿。

text_en: The Lord kills and brings to life; he brings down to Sheol and raises up.
text_cn: 上主使人死，也使人活；使人降入阴府，也将人由阴府提出；

text_en: The Lord makes poor and makes rich; he brings low, he also exalts.
text_cn: 上主使人穷，也使人富；贬抑人，也举扬人；

text_en: He raises up the poor from the dust; he lifts the needy from the ash heap, to make them sit with princes and inherit a seat of honor. For the pillars of the earth are the Lord ’s, and on them he has set the world.
text_cn: 上主由尘埃中提拔卑贱者，从粪土中高举贫穷者，使他与王侯同席，承受光荣座位；大地支柱原属上主，支柱上奠定了世界。

text_en: “He will guard the feet of his faithful ones, but the wicked shall be cut off in darkness; for not by might does one prevail.
text_cn: 他保护虔诚者的脚步，使恶人在黑暗中灭亡，因为人决不能凭己力获胜，

text_en: The Lord ! His adversaries shall be shattered; the Most High will thunder in heaven. The Lord will judge the ends of the earth; he will give strength to his king, and exalt the power of his anointed. ”
text_cn: 那与上主敌对的必被粉碎。至高者在天上鸣雷，上主要裁判地极，赐予自己的君王能力，高举受傅者的冠冕。”

text_en: Then Elkanah went home to Ramah, while the boy remained to minister to the Lord , in the presence of the priest Eli.
text_cn: 以后厄耳卡纳回了辣玛本家。幼童却留在厄里大司祭前，奉事上主。

text_en: Now the sons of Eli were scoundrels; they had no regard for the Lord
text_cn: 厄里的两个儿子原是无恶不做的人，不怀念上主，

text_en: or for the duties of the priests to the people. When anyone offered sacrifice, the priest’s servant would come, while the meat was boiling, with a three-pronged fork in his hand,
text_cn: 也不关心司祭对人民的义务；若有人来杀牲献祭，到煮祭肉时，司祭的僮仆便来，手持三齿叉，

text_en: and he would thrust it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; all that the fork brought up the priest would take for himself. This is what they did at Shiloh to all the Israelites who came there.
text_cn: 插入鼎里，锅里，甑（zèng）里或镬（huò）里，凡叉上来的，司祭就拿去自用；他们常这样对待所有到史罗来的以色列人。

text_en: Moreover, before the fat was burned, the priest’s servant would come and say to the one who was sacrificing, “Give meat for the priest to roast; for he will not accept boiled meat from you, but only raw. ”
text_cn: 甚或在焚化油脂以前，司祭的僮仆来对献祭的人说：“把肉给司祭去烤吧！他不向你要熟肉，他要生肉。”

text_en: And if the man said to him, “Let them burn the fat first, and then take whatever you wish, ” he would say, “No, you must give it now; if not, I will take it by force. ”
text_cn: 如果人答应说：“先得将油脂焚化，然后你可随意拿去。”他必答说：“不，应立刻给我；不然，我就来抢。”

text_en: Thus the sin of the young men was very great in the sight of the Lord ; for they treated the offerings of the Lord with contempt.
text_cn: 这两个少年人在上主前犯的罪极重，因为轻视了献于上主的祭品。

text_en: Samuel was ministering before the Lord , a boy wearing a linen ephod.
text_cn: 撒慕尔幼童穿着细麻的“厄弗得”，在上主面前供职。

text_en: His mother used to make for him a little robe and take it to him each year, when she went up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
text_cn: 他的母亲每年给他做一件小外氅（chǎng），当她同丈夫上来献年祭时，就给他带来。

text_en: Then Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, and say, “May the Lord repay you with children by this woman for the gift that she made to the Lord ”; and then they would return to their home.
text_cn: 厄里祝福厄耳卡纳和他的妻子说：“愿上主由这妇人再赏你一个儿子，代替献给上主的这一个！”然后他们就回了本乡。

text_en: And the Lord took note of Hannah; she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. And the boy Samuel grew up in the presence of the Lord .
text_cn: 上主看顾了亚纳，她怀孕生了三男二女。撒慕尔幼童在上主前渐渐长大。

text_en: Now Eli was very old. He heard all that his sons were doing to all Israel, and how they lay with the women who served at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
text_cn: 厄里已经很老。他听说他的两个儿子对众以色列人所做的一切，和他们与在会幕门旁服役的妇女同睡的事，

text_en: He said to them, “Why do you do such things? For I hear of your evil dealings from all these people.
text_cn: 就对他们说：“你们为什么作出像我由众百姓那里听来的这些坏事？

text_en: No, my sons; it is not a good report that I hear the people of the Lord spreading abroad.
text_cn: 我儿，不要这样！我所听见的风声实在不好，你们竟使百姓远离了上主！

text_en: If one person sins against another, someone can intercede for the sinner with the Lord ; but if someone sins against the Lord , who can make intercession? ” But they would not listen to the voice of their father; for it was the will of the Lord to kill them.
text_cn: 人若得罪人，尚有天主审断；人若得罪上主，有谁为他求情呢？”但是他们仍不听父亲的话，因为上主有意使他们丧亡。

text_en: Now the boy Samuel continued to grow both in stature and in favor with the Lord and with the people.
text_cn: 撒慕尔幼童渐渐长大，为上主和人所喜爱。

text_en: A man of God came to Eli and said to him, “Thus the Lord has said, ‘I revealed myself to the family of your ancestor in Egypt when they were slaves to the house of Pharaoh.
text_cn: 有一位天主的人来到厄里面前对他说：“上主这样说：当你祖先的家人还在埃及法郎家中当奴隶时，我不是再三显现给他们吗？

text_en: I chose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to offer incense, to wear an ephod before me; and I gave to the family of your ancestor all my offerings by fire from the people of Israel.
text_cn: 我不是从以色列众支派中，特选了他们作我的司祭，上我的祭坛焚香献祭，穿‘厄弗得’到我面前来，并将以色列子民的火祭祭品全赐给了你的父家吗？

text_en: Why then look with greedy eye at my sacrifices and my offerings that I commanded, and honor your sons more than me by fattening yourselves on the choicest parts of every offering of my people Israel? ’
text_cn: 那么，你为什么还要嫉视我所规定的牺牲和素祭呢？竟重视你的儿子在我以上，用我的人民以色列所献的最好的一份，养肥了他们？

text_en: Therefore the Lord the God of Israel declares: ‘I promised that your family and the family of your ancestor should go in and out before me forever’; but now the Lord declares: ‘Far be it from me; for those who honor me I will honor, and those who despise me shall be treated with contempt.
text_cn: 因此，请听上主以色列天主的断语：我曾许下，你的家和你的父家要在我面前永远往来，但是现在，──上主的断语──决不能如此！只有那光荣我的，我才光荣他；那轻视我的，必受轻视。

text_en: See, a time is coming when I will cut off your strength and the strength of your ancestor’s family, so that no one in your family will live to old age.
text_cn: 时日快到了，那时我要砍下你的臂膊和你父家的臂膊，使你家里再没有权威的长者。

text_en: Then in distress you will look with greedy eye on all the prosperity that shall be bestowed upon Israel; and no one in your family shall ever live to old age.
text_cn: 以后，你要嫉视我赐与以色列人的一切幸福，可是在你家里永不会再有权威的长者；

text_en: The only one of you whom I shall not cut off from my altar shall be spared to weep out his eyes and grieve his heart; all the members of your household shall die by the sword.
text_cn: 我也不愿将你的人由我的祭坛上尽行消灭，致使你的眼目昏花，心神忧伤；但你家中大多数的人要死在人家的刀下。

text_en: The fate of your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, shall be the sign to you—both of them shall die on the same day.
text_cn: 你的两个儿子曷弗尼和丕乃哈斯所要遭遇的，为你就是个先兆：他们两人要在同一天死掉。

text_en: I will raise up for myself a faithful priest, who shall do according to what is in my heart and in my mind. I will build him a sure house, and he shall go in and out before my anointed one forever.
text_cn: 我要为我兴起一位忠信的司祭，他要照我的心意行事，我要给他建立一个坚固的家庭，他一生要在我的受傅者前往来。

text_en: Everyone who is left in your family shall come to implore him for a piece of silver or a loaf of bread, and shall say, Please put me in one of the priest’s places, that I may eat a morsel of bread. ’”
text_cn: 那时，凡你家中所存留的人，必要叩拜他，为得到一点钱或一片饼说：求你容我参与任何一种司祭职务，使我可以糊口。”
